info.title: Windshift API v2
info.description: Canonical API v2. Browser clients use the session-authenticated /api/v2 mount; non-browser clients use this bearer-authenticated mount.

tags.name: Work items
tags.description: Work items and their supporting content.

tags.name: Workspace configuration
tags.description: Workspace types, statuses, workflows, and settings.

tags.name: Test management
tags.description: Test cases, plans, runs, and coverage.

get.summary: Get the API v2 OpenAPI document
get.description: Returns the canonical API v2 contract used by this server.
Returns the authenticated user. Bearer clients require the `users:read` scope; resource permissions still apply.

Lists work items visible to the caller. `collection_id` takes precedence over `workspace_id`; `ql` takes precedence over structured filters. Cursor pagination is available only for an unfiltered workspace list.

post.description: Creates a work item in a workspace. Omitted configuration fields use workspace defaults; unknown JSON fields are rejected.

get.description: Returns up to 500 visible items for a comma-separated set of IDs. Missing or inaccessible IDs are omitted.
Returns one visible work item with its joined display fields.

patch.description: Applies a JSON Merge Patch to editable item fields. Omitted fields are unchanged; nullable fields can be cleared with `null`.

delete.description: Deletes item. Bearer clients require the `items:delete` scope; resource permissions still apply.

get.description: Returns the aggregate bootstrap document used by an item detail screen. `surface=mobile` omits desktop-only sections.
Returns one visible work item by its workspace key and workspace-scoped number.

get.summary: Get item detail summary by key
get.description: Returns the aggregate item-detail bootstrap document by workspace key and item number. `surface=mobile` omits desktop-only sections.
Lists the item's visible direct children in their stored order.
Lists the visible parent chain from the item's root ancestor down to its immediate parent.
Lists visible descendants recursively. `max_depth=0` means no depth limit.
Totals estimates and logged minutes for the item and descendants up to the requested depth.
Lists recorded item field changes with permission-filtered actor details and resolved display values.
Returns accumulated time in each status, calculated from the item's transition history.
Reports whether the authenticated user watches the item.

post.description: Starts watching the item for the authenticated user. Repeating the request is safe.

delete.description: Stops watching the item for the authenticated user and returns the resulting watch state.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's personal tasks linked to this work item.

delete.description: Unlink item related work item. Bearer clients require the `items:write` scope; resource permissions still apply.

get.description: Lists backlog items for either a workspace or collection. At least one selector is required; collection selection takes precedence.
Returns item membership changes after a watermark so clients can refresh incrementally. A missing or stale watermark can require a full reload.

post.description: Applies the same field set to at most 500 items atomically. Any missing item, permission denial, or invalid field rolls back the entire request.
Applies distinct field sets to at most 5,000 unique items atomically. Any failure rolls back every item update.
Returns a minimal date projection for up to 500 roots and their descendants. Results are capped at 5,000 items and report truncation.

get.description: Returns hierarchy impact information used to choose between direct and cascading deletion.

delete.description: Deletes the item and every descendant, returning the number of deleted items.

post.description: Moves every direct child to the supplied parent. Use `null` to make the children top-level items.
Creates a copy of the item in the same workspace and returns the new item.
Previews field, label, child, type, status, and priority changes without moving the item.
Moves the item to another workspace using the selected destination type, status, and priority mappings.

patch.description: Moves an item between optional neighboring items. Omit the previous or next ID to place it at that end of the list; retry after a `409` conflict with refreshed neighbors.

get.description: Returns transitions currently available from the item's status, including any pending approval gate.

post.description: Transitions the item through its configured workflow. Conditions and approval gates can reject the request.

get.description: Previews workflow and status migration requirements for changing the item's type.

post.description: Changes the item's type and optionally migrates it to a compatible target status. A `409` identifies a required but omitted status migration.

BearerAuth.description: Use a Windshift API token. Each operation lists its enforced token scopes in x-required-scopes; session clients use the /api/v2 mount and do not send bearer credentials. The authenticated /api/api-tokens/scope-catalog endpoint returns every grantable scope with picker labels and descriptions.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Maximum number of results to return on one page.

ItemWorkspaceFilter.name: workspace_id
ItemWorkspaceFilter.description: Restrict items to this workspace. Ignored when collection_id is present.

ItemCollectionFilter.name: collection_id
ItemCollectionFilter.description: Evaluate the saved collection and restrict results to its membership. Takes precedence over workspace_id.

ItemQL.name: ql
ItemQL.description: QL expression used as the primary item filter. When present, structured filters other than search and status inclusion/exclusion are ignored.

ItemSubQL.name: sub_ql
ItemSubQL.description: Additional QL expression combined with the primary collection or QL filter.

ItemSearch.name: search
ItemSearch.description: Case-insensitive text search applied to item content.

ItemTypeFilter.name: item_type_id
ItemTypeFilter.description: Restrict items to one item type.

ItemIDFilter.name: id
ItemIDFilter.description: Restrict the collection to one item ID.

ItemParentFilter.name: parent_id
ItemParentFilter.description: Restrict items to one parent ID. Use the literal `null` for top-level items.

ItemLevelFilter.name: level
ItemLevelFilter.description: Restrict items to an exact hierarchy level.

ItemMaxLevelFilter.name: max_level
ItemMaxLevelFilter.description: Restrict items to this hierarchy level or shallower.

ItemCreatedSinceFilter.name: created_since
ItemCreatedSinceFilter.description: Include items created on or after this ISO date.

ItemCompletedSinceFilter.name: completed_since
ItemCompletedSinceFilter.description: For completed statuses, include only items completed on or after this ISO date; incomplete items remain included.

ItemSort.name: sort
ItemSort.description: Sort by a system field key or numeric custom-field ID. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

ItemCursor.name: cursor
ItemCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in meta.next_cursor. Supported only for an unfiltered workspace list.

ItemFields.name: fields
ItemFields.description: Use `summary` to omit item descriptions from list rows.

IncludeWatermark.name: include_watermark
IncludeWatermark.description: Include the current item-change watermark in response metadata.

ItemIDs.name: ids
ItemIDs.description: Comma-separated item IDs. Duplicate IDs are collapsed; at most 500 unique IDs are accepted. Omission returns an empty result.

ItemDetailSurface.name: surface
ItemDetailSurface.description: Use `mobile` to omit desktop-only detail sections.

ItemDescendantDepth.name: max_depth
ItemDescendantDepth.description: Maximum descendant depth. Zero means unlimited.

ItemRollupDepth.name: max_depth
ItemRollupDepth.description: Maximum hierarchy depth included in the time rollup.

ItemChangeWatermark.name: since
ItemChangeWatermark.description: Return changes after this non-negative item-change watermark. Omit it to request a full-reload decision.

TargetItemType.name: target_item_type_id
TargetItemType.description: Item type to evaluate as the migration target.

total_pages.description: Total pages for the requested page size.

PersonalLabel.description: A user-owned label attached to a personal task.

user_id.description: Owning user; null for a global personal label.

CalendarScheduleEntry.description: The authenticated user's calendar placement for an item.

user_id.description: User whose calendar contains the entry.

workspace_id.description: Personal workspace containing the calendar entry.

scheduled_time.description: Optional local start time in HH:MM form.

MilestoneSummary.description: Milestone fields embedded in an item response.

is_global.description: Whether the milestone is shared globally.

workspace_id.description: Owning workspace for a local milestone.

Item.description: A work item with stable identifiers and permission-filtered joined display fields.

workspace_item_number.description: Sequential number unique within the workspace.

key.description: Ready-to-display workspace key and item number.

description.description: Markdown source for the item description.

description_html.description: Rendered safe HTML for the description.

is_task.description: Whether this is a checklist-style task.

inherit_project.description: Whether time-project membership is inherited from the parent.

time_project_id.description: Per-item project override used when logging time.

creator_id.description: Internal user who created the item.

creator_portal_customer_id.description: Portal customer who created the item.

request_type_id.description: Portal request type used for submission.

custom_field_values.description: Stored custom-field values keyed by field identifier.

parent_id.description: Direct parent item; null for a root item.

parent_key.description: Display key of the parent item.

related_work_item_id.description: Work item linked from a personal task.

frac_index.description: Opaque fractional rank used for manual ordering.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the item most recently entered a completed status.

workspace_key.description: Workspace key used in item display keys.

status_since.description: Timestamp when the item entered its current status.

project_inheritance_mode.description: How the effective project was selected.

labels.description: Shared labels attached to the item.

personal_labels.description: Personal labels attached to the item.

ItemCreateRequest.description: Fields accepted when creating an item.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that will own the item.

description.description: Markdown description, limited to 256 KiB when UTF-8 encoded.

status_id.description: Initial status; omitted or null uses the workspace default.

item_type_id.description: Item type; omitted or null uses the workspace default.

inherit_project.description: Inherit time-project membership from the parent.

time_project_id.description: Per-item project override for time logging.

related_work_item_id.description: Related work item for a personal task.

custom_field_values.description: Custom-field values keyed by field identifier.

ItemPatchRequest.description: Editable item fields. Each property is optional; explicit null clears nullable fields.

description.description: Replacement Markdown description, limited to 256 KiB when UTF-8 encoded; null clears it.

assignee_id.description: Replacement assignee; null unassigns the item.

parent_id.description: Replacement parent; null makes the item top-level.

iteration_id.description: Replacement iteration; null removes the assignment.

project_id.description: Replacement direct time project; null clears it.

milestone_ids.description: Complete replacement milestone set; null clears all milestones.

due_date.description: Replacement due timestamp; null clears it.

start_date.description: Replacement start timestamp; null clears it.

end_date.description: Replacement end timestamp; null clears it.

is_task.description: Replacement checklist-task flag; null is treated as false.

custom_field_values.description: Complete custom-field value map; null clears all values.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded for the watch.

ItemBulkFields.description: Fields accepted by atomic bulk item updates.

item_ids.description: Items receiving the shared field set.

patches.description: Distinct patches; each item ID may appear only once.

root_ids.description: Visible hierarchy roots to expand. Omission or an empty array returns an empty result.

parent_id.description: New parent for all direct children; null or omission makes them top-level.

destination_workspace_id.description: Workspace that will receive the item.

target_item_type_id.description: Compatible destination item type; omission selects the preview default.

target_status_id.description: Compatible destination status; omission selects the preview default.

target_priority_id.description: Compatible destination priority; null clears priority.

ItemRankRequest.description: Neighbor IDs defining the item's new position.

previous_item_id.description: Item immediately before the new position; null means the start.

next_item_id.description: Item immediately after the new position; null means the end.

to_status_id.description: Destination status from the available transition set.

target_status_id.description: Compatible target status when workflow migration is required.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next eligible item page.

sortable_fields.description: System and custom fields currently available for sorting.

ItemDetailSummary.description: Aggregate bootstrap state for the item detail screen.

links.description: Incoming and outgoing entity links visible to the caller.

link_types.description: Link types available for this item.

request_type_fields.description: Portal request fields visible for this item.

watching.description: Whether the authenticated user watches this item.

available_sub_issue_types.description: Item types allowed beneath this item.

manual_actions.description: Manual automations available to the caller.

has_agent_runs.description: Whether the item has coding-agent runs.

item_count.description: Root and descendant items included in the totals.

truncated.description: Whether the server cap prevented a complete descendant traversal.

is_agent.description: Whether the actor is an agent.

agent_owner_name.description: Permission-filtered owner name for an agent actor.

is_current.description: Whether this is the item's current status.

calculated_at.description: Timestamp through which durations were calculated.

watching.description: Current watch state for the authenticated user.

changed_item_ids.description: Items changed since the supplied watermark.

removed_item_ids.description: Items removed from the selected result set.

watermark.description: Watermark to send with the next incremental request.

requires_full_reload.description: Whether the caller must discard its cached list and reload it.

membership_dirty.description: Whether collection membership may have changed independently of item rows.

atomic.description: Always true: either every requested change commits or none do.

updated_count.description: Number of items whose stored values changed.

unchanged_count.description: Number of items already matching the requested values.

items.description: Hydrated items that changed, in deterministic item-ID order.

parent_id.description: Parent item, or null for a root.

items.description: Distinct roots and descendants ordered by item ID.

truncated.description: Whether the 5,000-item result cap was reached.

has_children.description: Whether the item has direct children.

descendant_count.description: Total number of descendants affected by cascading deletion.

count.description: Number of items affected by the mutation.

is_default.description: Whether this is the proposed default mapping.

fields.description: Fields that will be kept, cleared, or mapped.

labels_kept.description: Label names retained in the destination.

labels_dropped.description: Label names unavailable in the destination.

custom_fields_kept.description: Custom-field names retained in the destination.

custom_fields_dropped.description: Custom-field names unavailable in the destination.

children_detached.description: Direct children that will be detached.

new_key.description: Display key assigned in the destination workspace.

builtin_key.description: Stable built-in status key, or an empty string for custom statuses.

value.description: Destination status value used by clients.

you_can_decide.description: Whether the authenticated user can decide this approval.

available_transitions.description: Workflow destinations currently available to the caller.

no_op.description: Whether the item was already in the destination status.

requires_migration.description: Whether the current status is unavailable in the target workflow.

available_statuses.description: Statuses compatible with the target workflow.

can_change_without_status.description: Whether target_status_id can be omitted when applying the change.
